scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ipa
scripts.test:coverage:unit: c8 --temp-directory coverage/.tmp-unit --report-dir coverage/unit --reporter=json --reporter=text --include "scripts/**" --include "macronizer/dist/**" --exclude "scripts/tests/**" mocha scripts/tests/unit/*.test.js --require scripts/tests/setup.cjs --timeout 20000
scripts.test:coverage:ipa: c8 --temp-directory coverage/.tmp-ipa --report-dir coverage/ipa --reporter=json --reporter=text --include "scripts/**" --include "macronizer/dist/**" --exclude "scripts/tests/**" -- mocha scripts/tests/get_ipa.test.js scripts/tests/golden.test.js --require scripts/tests/setup.cjs --timeout 60000
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:unit && npm run test:coverage:ipa && npm run test:coverage:e2e && node scripts/tests/coverage-merge.mjs
